description: An enum's fixed underlying type widens (unsigned char -> unsigned int) and the enum is passed by value. Built without debug info, so only the header model sees the change: it must read as one enum_underlying_size_changed, not NO_CHANGE. Before the fix the size change came only from the DWARF layout pass.
